episode_title: Want ChatGPT to Recommend Your AEC Firm? Start Here: Daniela Furtado

real_qa.q: How much of Findable Digital Marketing's client acquisition comes from Google versus referrals and other channels?
real_qa.r: About 30 to 40 percent of Findable's clients come from Google, and another 30 to 40 percent comes from referrals—primarily through networking on LinkedIn and industry events rather than direct client recommendations, since referring competitors would create conflicts of interest. The remaining portion comes from public speaking, workshops, and conferences.
real_qa.requete: Findable Digital Marketing client acquisition channels

real_qa.q: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and how does it differ from traditional SEO for AEC firms?
real_qa.r: GEO, or Generative Engine Optimization, is how AI search engines like ChatGPT cite or recommend a company to users searching with specific prompts. According to Danny Sullivan speaking at a Google Canada conference, good GEO is actually good SEO—it is not a separate strategy. The key difference is that AI search relies on consistent patterns across all online platforms rather than measurable keyword searches like traditional SEO, making frequency and consistency critical.
real_qa.requete: what is Generative Engine Optimization GEO

real_qa.q: What is the most effective starting point for established AEC firms with minimal digital footprint who want to improve online visibility?
real_qa.r: Google Maps local SEO is the lowest hanging fruit, especially for established firms with physical locations and decades of past clients. Creating and optimizing a Google Maps listing, asking past clients for reviews consistently—targeting three reviews per week for three months—can help established firms rank higher than younger competitors who lack physical locations and accumulated testimonials.
real_qa.requete: Google Maps local SEO for construction firms

real_qa.q: How does consistency across multiple online platforms affect AI search engine recommendations for AEC professionals?
real_qa.r: AI search engines look for patterns in how consistently a person or firm appears across all online platforms—website, LinkedIn, podcasts, YouTube, social media, directories, associations, awards, and PR mentions. When someone comes up consistently with the same positioning and messaging, AI understands the through line and pattern, making it easier to recommend them to users. This consistency matters more than any single channel.
real_qa.requete: consistency online platforms AI search recommendations

real_qa.q: How personalized are ChatGPT and other AI search results compared to Google search results?
real_qa.r: According to research cited, for every 200 identical searches on Google, you get the exact same 10 results in approximately 146 of the 200 searches, whereas on ChatGPT the consistency ratio is much lower—around 6 out of 1000 searches return identical results. This massive difference shows how personalized AI results are based on each user's context and previous conversation history with the AI.
real_qa.requete: ChatGPT personalization versus Google search consistency
